situation.name: drug_use_dynamics_south_africa
situation.description: SIR-type model for illicit drug use dynamics with compartments: Susceptible, Light drug users, Heavy drug users, Mentally ill, and Detected/Rehabilitation. Includes optimal control for reducing social influence and increasing detection/rehabilitation.

article.name: Modeling Illicit Drug Use Dynamics and Its Optimal Control Analysis
article.author: Mushayabasa, S., Tapedzesa, G.

data.name: south_africa_drug_use_data
data.place: Cape Town, Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Durban communities (1996-2008)
data.source: Computational and Mathematical Methods in Medicine, Volume 2015, Article ID 383154

compartments.name: light_drug_users
compartments.expression: dI/dt = lambda*S - (alpha + gamma + sigma + mu + psi)*I

params.name: recruitment_rate
params.meaning: Recruitment rate and non-drug-related death rate (per year)

params.name: transmission_rate
params.meaning: Strength of interactions between susceptibles and drug users (per year)

params.name: modification_factor
params.meaning: Modification factor for heavy users influence (kappa >= 1)

params.name: force_of_infection
params.meaning: Force of infection: lambda = beta*(I + kappa*Ia)

params.name: escalation_rate
params.meaning: Rate light users become heavy users (per year)

params.name: detection_light_users
params.meaning: Detection and rehabilitation rate for light users (per year)

params.name: detection_heavy_users
params.meaning: Detection and rehabilitation rate for heavy users (per year)

params.name: detection_mentally_ill
params.meaning: Detection and rehabilitation rate for mentally ill (per year)

params.name: mental_illness_light
params.meaning: Rate light users develop mental illness (per year)

params.name: mental_illness_heavy
params.meaning: Rate heavy users develop mental illness (per year, phi >= sigma)

params.name: exit_light_users
params.meaning: Permanent exit rate for light users (cessation or death) (per year)

params.name: exit_heavy_users
params.meaning: Permanent exit rate for heavy users (cessation or death) (per year)

params.name: mental_illness_death
params.meaning: Drug use-related death rate for mentally ill (per year)

params.name: recovery_rate
params.meaning: Recovery rate from rehabilitation (per year)

params.name: basic_reproductive_number
params.meaning: Rd = beta*(alpha*kappa + mu + rho + phi + d) / ((alpha + gamma + mu + sigma + psi)*(mu + rho + phi + d))

situation.name: drug_use_optimal_control
situation.description: Extended drug use model with two time-dependent control functions: u(t) reduces social influence between susceptibles and drug users, V(t) increases detection and rehabilitation rates.

article.name: Modeling Illicit Drug Use Dynamics and Its Optimal Control Analysis
article.author: Mushayabasa, S., Tapedzesa, G.

data.name: south_africa_drug_use_optimal_control
data.place: Cape Town, Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Durban communities
data.source: Computational and Mathematical Methods in Medicine, Volume 2015, Article ID 383154

params.name: recruitment_rate
params.meaning: Recruitment and death rate (per year)

params.name: transmission_rate
params.meaning: Interaction strength (per year)

params.name: modification_factor
params.meaning: Heavy user influence factor (kappa >= 1)

params.name: escalation_rate
params.meaning: Light to heavy user escalation rate (per year)

params.name: detection_light_users
params.meaning: Base detection rate for light users (per year)

params.name: detection_heavy_users
params.meaning: Base detection rate for heavy users (per year)

params.name: detection_mentally_ill
params.meaning: Base detection rate for mentally ill (per year)

params.name: mental_illness_light
params.meaning: Light user mental illness rate (per year)

params.name: mental_illness_heavy
params.meaning: Heavy user mental illness rate (per year)

params.name: exit_light_users
params.meaning: Light user exit rate (per year)

params.name: exit_heavy_users
params.meaning: Heavy user exit rate (per year)

params.name: mental_illness_death
params.meaning: Mentally ill death rate (per year)

params.name: recovery_rate
params.meaning: Rehabilitation recovery rate (per year)

params.name: control_social_influence
params.meaning: Control function reducing social influence (0 <= u <= 1)

params.name: control_detection
params.meaning: Control function increasing detection/rehabilitation (0 <= V <= 1)

params.name: cost_weight_u
params.meaning: Balancing coefficient for u(t) cost

params.name: cost_weight_V
params.meaning: Balancing coefficient for V(t) cost

params.name: objective_functional
params.meaning: J = integral_0^T [I + Ia + A*u^2 + B*V^2] dt
